Cloud operations need more than reactive troubleshooting, they demand intelligent observability that scales across resources and delivers actionable insights when services aren’t performing as expected.Introducing the Azure Copilot observability agent that brings a streamlined experience powered by AI-driven investigations, deeper visibility, and faster resolution.Why It Matters:Smarter insights, faster recovery across your Azure stackAutomatic anomaly detection from metrics, logs, and observability signalsCorrelated findings with clear next steps in natural languageIntegrated experience with alerts, Azure portal, and Azure Copilot (preview)Expanded Capabilities:The agent
now investigates issues across any Azure resource, including Application
Insights (AI), Virtual Machines (VM) and Azure Kubernetes Service
(AKS) Metric analysis for CPU, memory, and network patternsResource health checks and diagnostics integration for quick remediationLog-enriched anomaly detection for precise root cause identificationWhat’s New:Extended regional availability – now supported in most Azure regionsCopilot support – interact naturally with alerts and dive into investigations with one clickLearn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Azure Copilot observability agent
